Robert Half is currently recruiting a Financial & Business Controller (M/V/X) - Region Antwerp

Our client is an entrepreneurial investment-focused organization with activities across long-term investing and financial services.

The company combines a strategic, hands-on approach with a strong focus on sustainable growth, financial discipline, and value creation.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Financial & Business Controller (M/V/X) include:

• You oversee the financial performance of the organization's investment and financial services activities, ensuring timely, accurate, and decision-relevant reporting.
• You coordinate annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning, while challenging assumptions and tracking performance against objectives.
• You define, monitor, and analyze financial and operational KPIs, identifying trends, risks, opportunities, and value drivers for management.
• You prepare and review business cases, financial models, scenario analyses, and benchmark studies to support strategic, investment, and financing decisions.
• You collaborate with the accounting team on monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, and contribute to statutory and consolidated reporting.
• You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc regulatory reporting and help ensure compliance with applicable requirements and deadlines.
• You manage periodic reporting for key stakeholders and provide clear, actionable financial insights.
• You monitor cash flow forecasts and liquidity positions and support financing-related analyses and stakeholder interactions.
• You help strengthen internal controls and continuously improve finance processes, data integrity, and operational efficiency.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a master's degree in finance, Accounting, Business Economics, or a related field, combined with at least 3 years of relevant experience in controlling, audit, transaction services, investment analysis, or a similar finance position.
• You have a strong understanding of financial statements, performance management, and IFRS, and you ideally bring affinity with investment environments, financial markets, or regulated financial services.
• You combine analytical strength with a critical and solution-oriented mindset, and you know how to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
• You work confidently with Excel, and experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered an asset.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English and are comfortable engaging with both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
• You are proactive, accurate, and intellectually curious, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
• You bring additional value if you have experience with project management, internal controls, risk management, regulatory reporting, or financing projects.

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

The Software & Services (SAS) Competence Centre is looking for a Application & Platform Security Architect to help shape the secure and sustainable digitalization of Vito. As our software landscape continues to grow, cybersecurity expectations in research and innovation projects increase, and regulations such as NIS2 become more important, we are looking for an expert who can develop an organization-wide architectural vision and translate it into practical guidelines, standards, and improvement initiatives. You will help research software evolve from prototypes into reliable operational solutions and support teams in integrating security, compliance, and best practices from the very start of their developments.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of around 30 software engineers, DevOps specialists, analysts, and project managers with a strong affinity for scientific research. Together, we bridge the gap between research and impact by developing digital solutions that make scientific insights accessible to industry, policymakers, and society.

Our expertise spans three main domains: application development, supporting researchers in building high-quality software, and providing scalable research platforms such as Kubernetes, cloud, and HPC environments. We combine software engineering, AI-assisted development, DevOps, cybersecurity, and data infrastructure to accelerate the transition from research to reliable operational solutions.

Within SAS, you will have the opportunity to work on challenges with real societal impact, collaborate with leading researchers, and contribute to an organization-wide culture of software engineering and innovation.
What will you do?

You will work closely with researchers, software engineers, DevOps specialists, and project teams to embed security by design into our digital solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Assessing the current security posture of Vito's internally developed applications and defining a phased roadmap towards NIS2 compliance.

• 
Defining, implementing, and maintaining security standards, architectural guidelines, and software development best practices across the organization.

• 
Developing policy frameworks, guidelines, and reusable building blocks to integrate cybersecurity into research proposals and innovation projects from the outset.

• 
Reviewing application architectures and development processes across a diverse software landscape, and identifying improvement opportunities related to security, quality, maintainability, and operational maturity.

• 
Supporting and coaching development teams in adopting secure coding principles, modern CI/CD practices, and scalable architectural patterns.

• 
Promoting a consistent and future-oriented software engineering approach in which security, compliance, and quality are built in by default.

• 
Acting as a bridge between IT, software development, and research, ensuring that innovative solutions can safely evolve from prototypes into operational services.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to make an organization-wide impact on how digital solutions are designed, developed, and operated within a leading research organization.

• 
A Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in software architecture, security architecture, application security, or a related field.

• 
Strong understanding of secure software development practices, application security principles, and modern software architectures.

• 
Experience with cloud-native technologies, container platforms (e.g. Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.

• 
Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulations such as NIS2, ISO 27001, OWASP, or similar.

• 
Experience conducting architecture reviews, risk assessments, and translating security requirements into practical guidance for development teams.

• 
The ability to balance security, usability, innovation, and operational realities in a research-driven environment.

• 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to collaborate effectively with researchers, developers, IT teams, and management.

• 
A proactive mindset with the ability to drive change and build consensus across diverse teams.

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is considered an asset.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in research, innovation, or R&D-driven environments.

• 
Knowledge of AI/ML platforms, data-intensive applications, or scientific software development.

• 
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, Togaf, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

• 
Experience establishing security governance, secure development frameworks, or organization-wide security improvement programs.
